item.text: {"search_note":"Search gap: I did not find a 2024 primary-source statement from Abiy clearly accepting the possibility of losing power in a free election. The strongest positive material is procedural and observer-based, not a direct democratic commitment.","evidence":[{"title":"Freedom in the World 2025 Country Report","publisher":"Freedom House","date":"2025","url":"https://freedomhouse.org/country/ethiopia/freedom-world/2025","summary":"the report says Abiy-era electoral-law and NEBE reforms improved electoral operations and encouraged more opposition participation, and that some outstanding legislative/regional elections held in June 2024 were peaceful and credible according to AU observers.","question_ids":["4B.1"]},{"title":"World Report 2024: Ethiopia","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-01-12","url":"https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2024/country-chapters/ethiopia","summary":"opposition parties still faced restrictions on assembly, harassment, arrest, and detention in defiance of court orders, which points to a political arena that was not meaningfully contestable.","question_ids":["4B.1","3B.8","3B.9"]},{"title":"Ethiopia’s Deepening Crackdown on Dissent","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-03-04","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/03/04/ethiopias-deepening-crackdown-dissent","summary":"HRW reported the detention of an opposition spokesperson and a journalist, and concluded that no one appeared safe from arbitrary arrest; this is direct evidence against free political contestation.","question_ids":["4B.1","3B.8","3B.9"]},{"title":"Ethiopia: Journalist arrested under state of emergency: Belay Manaye","publisher":"Amnesty International","date":"2024-03-14","url":"https://www.amnesty.org/en/documents/afr25/7782/2024/en/","summary":"Amnesty said a journalist was held under emergency powers for reporting on the Amhara conflict, and that other journalists had also been arbitrarily arrested under the state of emergency.","question_ids":["4B.1","3B.8","3B.9"]},{"title":"Ethiopia - Civicus Monitor","publisher":"CIVICUS Monitor","date":"2024-12-04","url":"https://monitor.civicus.org/press_release/2024/ethiopia/","summary":"civic space was downgraded to “Closed” amid conflict and emergency measures, with surveillance, harassment, intimidation, and threats used against journalists and opposition members.","question_ids":["4B.1","3B.8","3B.9"]},{"title":"Ethiopia authorities suspend three rights groups","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-12-02","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/12/02/ethiopia-authorities-suspend-three-rights-groups","summary":"the government suspended three rights groups while Abiy praised reforms, which looks like selective punishment of civic actors rather than acceptance of robust electoral competition.","question_ids":["4B.1","3B.8"]}]}
